research_result.description: Firecrawl is an API and toolset for web scraping, searching, crawling, and page interaction designed to deliver LLM-ready markdown and structured JSON to AI agents.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can start using Firecrawl immediately via rate-limited keyless access or sign up for a free account to receive an API key with 1,000 credits through the dashboard or CLI. OAuth authentication is also supported for hosted MCP and ID-JAG integration.

evidence.claim: Firecrawl authenticates API requests via an Authorization Bearer header using an API key.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: For authentication, it's required to include an Authorization header. The header should contain `Bearer fc-123456789`, where `fc-123456789` represents your API Key.

evidence.claim: Hosted Firecrawl supports OAuth bearer access tokens.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Hosted Firecrawl can issue OAuth access tokens (`fco_…`) via the authorization server on firecrawl.dev.

evidence.claim: Firecrawl offers free API keys with 1,000 free credits upon signup.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Sign up for a free API key to get 1,000 credits and higher rate limits at no cost — official clients automatically use your key once it's configured.

evidence.claim: Firecrawl provides a comprehensive REST API with v2 endpoints.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Canonical Firecrawl curl source of truth for agents. Aligned with `api-reference/v2-openapi.json` (server base URL `https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2`).

evidence.claim: Firecrawl provides an official MCP server for AI integration.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Set up Firecrawl MCP with keyless access, account sign-in, or an API key.
